providers.name: Kelo Content Packs
providers.notes: Declarative abilities and prebuilt scenes. Metadata is paged; inactive pages are hibernated. Tiny JSON is downloaded into the personal vault only after Download; no executable code is accepted.

providers.name: SpriteCook Free Assets
providers.notes: Machine-readable CC0 sprite catalog. Kelo renders only the active metadata page; previews and binary assets load only on explicit interaction.

providers.name: Kenney
providers.notes: Large CC0 catalog participates in federated search through paged metadata. Only the current page stays live; asset bytes are fetched only for Preview or Download.

providers.name: Universal LPC
providers.notes: LIVE verified animation subset from the canonical LPC repository. Metadata is paged and previews are loaded only when requested.

providers.name: OpenGameArt
providers.notes: LIVE curated metadata for sprites, animations, tiles, SFX, music and ambience. Metadata is paged; inactive pages are hibernated and Kelo never bulk-scrapes binary content from player devices.

providers.name: Poly Haven
providers.notes: Official CC0 API for textures, HDRIs and 3D models. Search-only metadata is hydrated per visible page. Kelo never fetches the full catalog or heavy binaries while browsing. Powered by Poly Haven.

providers.name: ambientCG
providers.notes: Official v3 API for CC0 materials, atlases, HDRIs, images and 3D models. Only bounded metadata and thumbnails are requested; heavy PBR/3D/HDRI archives never preload on mobile.

providers.name: Openverse Images
providers.notes: Huge open-media discovery index. Search only; no bulk browsing or automatic import. License metadata must be checked at the original source before integration. Made using Openverse; not endorsed by Openverse.

providers.name: Openverse Audio
providers.notes: Open audio discovery without mirroring the catalog. Search is bounded and source/license review remains mandatory before integration. Made using Openverse; not endorsed by Openverse.

providers.name: 3DAssets.dev
providers.notes: Large human-reviewed CC0 GLB catalog. Search-only API access; model files are never preloaded while browsing and remain source-resolved until a dedicated 3D import flow is invoked.

providers.name: Gobkit Free Models
providers.notes: Compact CORS-open manifest of free CC0 rigged characters, animals, dinosaurs and nature props. Metadata is cached; GLB bytes never load during catalog browsing.

providers.name: Quaternius
providers.notes: Curated CC0 Quaternius game-asset packs. Only tiny local metadata is searched; model archives remain at the official source and never preload on mobile.
